title: BILLING payload v1.0
description: One posted synthetic charge. Repeated business transaction references remain valid raw input.

transactionRef.description: Business transaction identity scoped to the subscriber; not the technical eventId.

amountMinor.description: Nonnegative charge in integer minor units; 12345 means 123.45 MDL. Refunds are out of scope.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency; the MVP supports MDL only, with 100 minor units per major unit.
